key_conclusions: Only renaming resume to pause-activation bypasses the existing supports_resume requirement and is not acceptable.
Root may authorize a separate exact sealed pause activation proof class, retaining all common admission checks and old generic resume contract.
Existing optional pauseActivationGate is insufficient as a required capability gate; absent schema or activation must explicitly reject.
Preparation at old epoch and launch/recovery at successor epoch need separate required proofs because the activation row does not exist before prepare.
Do not grant bootstrap or unqualified legacy fixture dispatch/resume authority.
Preserve supports_resume=false and resume_evidence_ref=null unless independent generic qualification contract is separately implemented and accepted.
